definitions.explanation: Without focus or attention; spacing out.

examples.japanese: ぼんやりと{窓|まど}の{外|そと}を{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: I was gazing vaguely out the window.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くの{山|やま}がぼんやり{見|み}える。
examples.english: The distant mountains can be seen dimly.

examples.japanese: ぼんやりしていて{電車|でんしゃ}を{乗|の}り{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I was spacing out and missed my train stop.

notes:
An onomatopoeic word with multiple related uses.

PATTERNS:
・ぼんやり(と)する (to space out, to be vague)
・ぼんやり(と){見|み}える (to be dimly visible)
・ぼんやりした + noun (vague, hazy)

COMMON USES:
・ぼんやりした{記憶|きおく} (vague memory)
・ぼんやりした{輪郭|りんかく} (blurry outline)
・ぼんやり{過|す}ごす (to spend time idly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・うっかり - carelessly (implies a mistake)
・ぼんやり - absent-mindedly (implies lack of focus)
・ぼーっと - spaced out, zoning out
